lede: Revol Carz Garage is a European car workshop at 10 Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2A, in the AMK AutoPoint building. Its website says it has been running since 2003 and services BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi and Volkswagen cars.
services: Original replacement parts, with OEM parts as an option for older cars
good_for: Its website states a minimum 1-year warranty on repairs
faqs: Which cars does Revol Carz Garage work on?
Its website lists European car servicing for BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi and Volkswagen.
Routine servicing, engine repair, transmission work and electrical fault diagnosis, using brand-specific diagnostic tools.
Its website says original replacement parts are used, and suggests OEM parts as a cost-effective option for older cars.
Its website states a minimum of 1 year on all repairs. Please confirm the terms with the workshop.
Where can I read about its past jobs?
The workshop publishes job write-ups on its own site. Two are summarised on this page, with links.
Sources differ, so please see Google Maps for current hours.

stories.title: BMW 730Li: front wheel bearing
stories.text: A 730Li came in with a hum that rose with road speed and a growl when cornering. The garage found a rough front wheel bearing on the driver side and fitted a new BMW-spec bearing. The write-up says the noise was gone after a short road test (job done 18 April 2026).

stories.title: BMW 116i: EVAP purge valve
stories.text: A 116i had a check engine light on for weeks, with a rough idle at traffic lights and slow cold starts. The garage traced it to a leaking EVAP purge valve using a smoke test and bench test, fitted a new valve and cleared the codes. The write-up says the idle was steady again (job done 2 May 2026).
